Sizzlipede

Fire Bug

Galar · Generation 8

Sizzlipede is a Fire/Bug-type Radiator Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 0.7 m tall and weighs 1 kg. It evolves into Centiskorch. Its highest base stat is Attack (65), with a base stat total of 305.
